issues.issue: ending_cash is a computed sum of two cash rows. The total equals the printed TOTAL ASSETS, which is all cash. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived, and Hooker_County_FY2024 leaves ending_cash null, so the treatment differs between years. A person should decide whether the printed TOTAL ASSETS counts as a printed cash figure.
The page prints only 'Intergovernmental'. Highway allocation is an assumption based on the fund name; the other Intergovernmental lines use other state aid.
